dataset_metadata.disclaimer: This is a SYNTHETIC/DEMO dataset created solely for testing the SIH competency intelligence platform. It does NOT represent actual live or private training schedules of NSSTA, MoSPI, or the Government of India.

programs.title: Professional Training on Sampling Design & Estimation Methods
programs.description: Intensive hands-on training covering mathematical sampling theories, variance estimation, and practical sampling design for national household surveys.
programs.eligibility_criteria: Officers in the Indian Statistical Service (ISS) or Subordinate Statistical Service (SSS) with at least 1 year of service.
programs.tpac_recommendation: Highly recommended by the Training Programme Advisory Committee (TPAC) for Statistical Officers prior to conducting field surveys.

programs.title: National Accounts Statistics Compilation Program
programs.description: Workshop on systemic compilation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP), GVA, and input-output transactions table using SNA 2008 frameworks.
programs.eligibility_criteria: Statistical Officers or Data Analysts working in the National Accounts Division (NAD) or Central Statistics Office (CSO).
programs.tpac_recommendation: Recommended by TPAC for officers involved in national income accounting.

programs.title: Geospatial Analysis and GIS for Official Statistics
programs.description: Hands-on training using QGIS for mapping census boundaries, plotting survey clusters, and integrating GIS with socio-economic data.
programs.eligibility_criteria: Any statistical staff working on GIS projects, mapping, or geographic classification.
programs.tpac_recommendation: Approved by TPAC as a modern capability building course for mapping units.

programs.title: Executive Leadership and Ethics in Official Statistics
programs.description: Focuses on strategic decision making, change management in digital transformation, and professional ethics under the Collection of Statistics Act.
programs.eligibility_criteria: Senior Statistical Officers, Directors, or Joint Directors with supervisory responsibilities.
programs.tpac_recommendation: Mandated by TPAC for promotional eligibility to Senior Administrative Grades.

programs.title: Advanced Sampling and Estimation Workshop
programs.description: Explores complex survey estimation models, regression estimators, calibration weighting, and correction for unit non-response.
programs.eligibility_criteria: Statistical Officers with at least 2 years of field survey experience.
programs.tpac_recommendation: Highly recommended by TPAC for research methodology enhancement.

programs.title: Cybersecurity and DPI Governance Seminar
programs.description: Training on security policies for government data centers, DPI architectures, and personal data safety workflows.
programs.eligibility_criteria: All IT and statistical staff involved in web application development or hosting operations.
programs.tpac_recommendation: TPAC mandated training for database administrators.

programs.title: AI/ML Applications in Agricultural Surveys
programs.description: Deep dive program on using remote sensing data, image recognition models, and spatial ML forecasts for crop yields estimation.
programs.eligibility_criteria: Officers in Agricultural Statistics divisions or GIS research teams.
programs.tpac_recommendation: Recommended by TPAC to leverage satellite imagery in crop yield analysis.

programs.title: Official Statistics Quality Auditing Workshop
programs.description: Intensive training on establishing statistical quality indicators and auditing national survey operations.
programs.eligibility_criteria: Statistical Officers or Supervisors in Quality Assurance cells.
programs.tpac_recommendation: Mandatory for designation as Statistical Audit Officers.
